lessons.title: What's the weather like?
lessons.scenario: Smarty phones his friends in different places. Tell him what the weather is like where you are.

items.note: Say 'It is sunny' when the sun is out and the sky is bright.

image.describe: Smarty the black cat sits on a green lawn in bright sunshine, with a big yellow sun in a clear blue sky.

items.note: Say 'It is rainy' when water is falling from the sky.

image.describe: Mia stands under grey clouds holding her hand out to the rain, with puddles on a park path and Smarty beside her.

items.note: Say 'It is windy' when the wind blows hard.

image.describe: Sam holds his hat on his head while strong wind bends the trees and blows leaves across the street.

items.note: Say 'It is cloudy' when grey clouds cover the sky and you cannot see the sun.

image.describe: Smarty looks up at a sky full of thick grey clouds with no sun.

items.note: Ask 'What is the weather like?' when you want to know about the sun, the rain or the wind.

practice.prompt: The sun is out and the sky is bright. Choose the sentence.
practice.explanation: Sunny is the word for a bright sky with the sun.

practice.prompt: Listen, then choose what you heard.
practice.explanation: Rainy is for rain. Listen to the weather word.

practice.prompt: Build the question about the weather.
practice.explanation: Ask with What is the weather like? to hear about the sky.

practice.prompt: Grey clouds cover the sky. Complete the sentence.
practice.explanation: Cloudy describes a sky full of clouds.

practice.prompt: Match each weather word to its sentence.
practice.explanation: Say It is + a weather word to talk about the weather.

practice.prompt: Say the sentence aloud. You can try again if the app mishears you.
practice.explanation: You can say this when you see a bright sky.

practice.prompt: Smarty asks: What is the weather like? Water is falling from the sky. Choose your reply.
practice.explanation: Answer the weather question with It is + the weather word.

practice.prompt: Strong wind blows the trees. Choose the weather word.
practice.explanation: Windy is when the wind blows hard.

practice.prompt: Listen, then choose what you heard.
practice.explanation: This question asks about the weather.

story.hook: Smarty phones three friends. Is the weather the same for everyone?

mission.setup: Smarty asks about the weather where you are. Say what it is like. The weather can be real or imaginary.

turns.hint: Say It is + sunny, rainy, windy or cloudy.

lessons.title: Rain and snow
lessons.scenario: It is a wet and cold day. Smarty and Sam talk about rain, snow and an umbrella.

items.note: Say 'snow' for the white, cold flakes that fall from the sky in winter weather.

image.describe: Mia and Sam in coats and scarves play in thick white snow while big flakes fall, and Smarty has snow on his head.

items.note: Say 'rain' for the water that falls from clouds; say 'It rains' when it is falling.

image.describe: Heavy rain falls from dark clouds onto a street while Smarty watches from a doorway.

items.note: Say 'It is warm' when the air is nice, not cold and not very hot.
Take an umbrella when it rains, so you stay dry.

image.describe: Leo holds a big red umbrella in the rain, and Smarty the black cat stays dry beside him.

practice.prompt: White flakes fall from the sky. Choose the sentence.
practice.explanation: Snow is white and falls from the sky. We say It snows.

practice.prompt: Listen, then choose what you heard.
practice.explanation: Umbrella is the word for the thing that keeps you dry in the rain.

practice.prompt: Say that the air is nice and not cold.
practice.explanation: Put the weather word at the end: It is warm.

practice.prompt: Water falls from the clouds. Complete the sentence.
practice.explanation: With rain we say It rains.

practice.prompt: Match each word to a sentence.
practice.explanation: Each sentence uses the word on the left.

practice.prompt: Say the sentence aloud. You can try again if the app mishears you.
practice.explanation: Use an before umbrella because it starts with a vowel sound.

practice.prompt: Mia wants to stay dry in the rain. Choose her sentence.
practice.explanation: An umbrella keeps you dry.

practice.prompt: The air is not cold and not hot. Choose the word.
practice.explanation: Warm is between cold and hot.

practice.prompt: Listen, then choose what you heard.
practice.explanation: Listen for the last word: snows.

Say No and use cold, or say It is cold.

lessons.title: Seasons
lessons.scenario: Smarty, Mia and Ben sit in the park and talk about their favourite seasons.

items.note: Say 'spring' for the season after winter, when it gets warm and flowers come.

image.describe: A bright park with fresh green leaves and pink flowers opening, while Smarty chases a butterfly.

items.note: Say 'summer' for the hot, sunny season.

image.describe: Sam and Mia play at a sunny beach under a big yellow sun, with Smarty in the shade.

items.note: Say 'autumn' for the season when leaves turn orange and fall and the wind blows.

image.describe: Orange and red leaves fall in a park while Ana kicks through the leaves and Smarty watches.

items.note: Say 'winter' for the cold season when it can snow.

image.describe: Tom and Leo in hats and scarves build a snowman in a snowy park, with Smarty in a tiny scarf.

items.note: Say 'season' when you talk about spring, summer, autumn or winter.

practice.prompt: Which season is hot and sunny?
practice.explanation: Summer is the hot season.

practice.explanation: Warm is not cold and not hot.

lessons.title: I like dancing
lessons.scenario: After school, friends say what they like doing: football, dancing, singing and drawing.

items.note: Say 'play football' for the game with a ball and a goal; use playing after I like.

image.describe: Sam kicks a football towards a goal on a green field while Smarty watches.

items.note: Say 'I like dancing' to tell what you enjoy; add -ing after like.

image.describe: Ana and Mia dance happily with their arms up, while Smarty taps his tail to the beat.

items.note: Say 'sing' when you make music with your voice.

image.describe: Omar sings happily with his mouth wide open, with music notes floating around, and Smarty listens.

items.note: Say 'draw' when you make a picture with a pencil.

image.describe: Lily draws a house with a pencil on paper at a table while Smarty sits on the table and watches.

practice.prompt: Sam kicks a ball into the goal. Choose the sentence.
practice.explanation: Play football is the phrase for this game.

practice.prompt: Listen, then choose what you heard.
practice.explanation: After like we add -ing: dancing.

practice.prompt: Say that you like to sing.
practice.explanation: I like + verb with -ing.

practice.explanation: With he we add s: he plays.

practice.prompt: Match each action to its sentence.
practice.explanation: After I like, the action word ends in -ing.

practice.prompt: Say that you like the hot season.
practice.explanation: I like + a season.

practice.explanation: Drawing is making pictures.
